added_failures_note: measured from the reviewed run's own suite/base and suite/head gate logs (twelve pytest chunks each arm): head failure ids minus base failure ids is empty

findings.text: blocking: _git_head remembers "outside any repository" on any _run_git failure - a ten-second timeout, a spawn error, a dubious-ownership refusal or an unborn HEAD - and _git_directory only tests the root's own .git, so a docs root nested inside a repository but without its own .git (where git resolves HEAD by walking up) is remembered as outside and every later age and HEAD lookup answers no commit without spawning, silently falling back to plan-modified ages until that directory's mtime changes; the worktree currently carries an uncommitted repair of exactly this distinction, showing git's own not-a-repository verdict apart from every other failure.

follow-on: baseline_suite and after_suite name the directories suite/base and suite/head rather than a log file, so the production reader annotate_review_of_run (reckon/crew/review.py:1683 _read_gate_log) resolves them as files, gets None, and records the added-failure count as unmeasured, so the added-failure total cap can never be applied to this run.
